title: TEST DATA - placeholder values, NOT IEEE 1584

_format.configs: One entry per electrode configuration: VCB, VCBB, HCB. Leave out any you don't need.
_format.ia: IEEE 1584-2018 Table 1 coefficients k1 to k10 for the intermediate arcing current at 600, 2700 and 14300 V, in order [k1, k2, k3, k4, k5, k6, k7, k8, k9, k10]. Used in Eq 1: Iarc = 10^(k1 + k2 lg Ibf + k3 lg G) x (k4 Ibf^6 + k5 Ibf^5 + k6 Ibf^4 + k7 Ibf^3 + k8 Ibf^2 + k9 Ibf + k10).
_format.varcf: IEEE 1584-2018 Table 2 coefficients k1 to k7 for the arcing current variation factor, in order [k1 ... k7]. VarCf = k1 Voc^6 + k2 Voc^5 + k3 Voc^4 + k4 Voc^3 + k5 Voc^2 + k6 Voc + k7.
_format.title: Shown on the page and in the PDF. Change it to say whose data this is, e.g. 'IEEE 1584-2018 Tables 1-2 (K. Dumigan copy)'. A title containing TEST or placeholder shows a warning.
